title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1982-10-09
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/24 (1 DVD FLAC)
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Outstanding outdoor audience recording with crystal‑clear sound capturing a high‑energy performance highlighted by stellar versions of Dupree’s Diamond Blues, Big River and Eyes.
ai_review.review: The recordings are praised as some of the most accurate and vivid audience tapes ever captured, delivering a crisp yet slightly boxy mix that still conveys the concert's atmosphere. The band delivers an inspired show with standout performances of “Dupree’s Diamond Blues,” “Big River,” and “Eyes,” keeping energy levels high throughout both sets.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are overwhelmingly positive (average 4.8 stars), highlighting both superb musical performance and exceptional recording quality, with only minor comments about slight boxiness.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very accurate, crisp and clear sound; reviewers note a slightly boxy or bass‑light character but overall consider it an outstanding outdoor audience capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show flows smoothly with high energy; both days are described as rocking and well‑played, with no reported lulls.
